periods.time: Interlude at Tokutomiya Charity Foundation and League Japan Branch

name.zh: 黑铁严确认播磨天童身份

periods.location: Tokutomiya Charity Foundation office; League Japan branch
periods.summary: Kanata is working on Wakaba House's neighborhood conflict when Itsuki Kurogane calls directly and warns that the old man sheltered there, Harima Tendo, is the escaped criminal Daien. Itsuki orders immediate evacuation and avoidance of combat, then calls Bukyoku Academy to specially summon Yudai Moroboshi and Byakuya Jounosaki as nearby assets capable of responding before Kurono can arrive.
periods.cause: Wakaba House had asked police to identify the old man; League Japan discovers he escaped from prison during a previous disturbance.
periods.process: Kanata learns that Tendo is a human disaster and tries to call Toka, but Toka is alone with Tendo at a graveyard. She reaches Misogi instead. Itsuki, knowing ordinary local knights would be slaughtered, selects Moroboshi for Tiger Bite and Jounosaki for Teleport.
periods.outcome: The crisis shifts from a local NIMBY problem to an emergency Daien response. Moroboshi and Jounosaki begin moving toward Kyushu while Toka remains exposed.
periods.significance: Starts the volume's main crisis and establishes that Daien is beyond normal Mage-Knight response.
